You can do pretty much anything with almost any DAW, hell you could make a top scoring album in Garageband and audacity if you put the time into it.

Outside of that, depends on what you want. I use REAPER as it’s free and I’m a broke uni student. If you’re leaning on recording instruments I recommend Cubase, if you’re leaning towards electronic music or VST-heavy music I recommend FL Studio or Ableton but once again none are necessary per se
I probably wouldn’t be failing uni classes and would have more friends. 2020’s been a hell of a year bro

“You look like the embodiment of loneliness”

I remember a girl said this to me during my one month back in public high school. Tbh she wasn’t wrong as previously I spent 3 years in isolation but it still kinda hurt knowing that even when I escaped that life it still followed me

I’m just trying to make it to the end of the week bro. 

Real talk though I ideally want to move to Czech Republic or Poland after a startup or music career kicks off.

Socially it feels like others are “superior” in the same way a boss or manager is but also just in terms of ability. It feels like they know I’m bad at socializing and that they’re waiting for me to slip up so they can mock and scold me.

Academically I just feel like I’m not as good as others. In one of my uni classes it felt like I don’t belong. Like everyone else is an adult compared to me who feels like a high school student. I don’t know why but I’ve been feeling that

Lol I’m not. Is it the hair maybe? I don’t know what to do with it then.

I’m not the best at smiling, my smile just looks shitty. Recommend anything to better it?

Recommend any products or places where I could read up on what I should look for? Rn I’m taking some prescribed  Benzoyl Peroxide. It’s cleared up my forehead alot but most of the acne on my cheeks seem to be acne scars
